description: Safety Scrub — Redact sensitive data from text before logging it or sending it to a model. Pure pattern matching, no AI call: masks payment card numbers, SSNs, API keys/tokens (sk-/gh_/AWS/Slack/Google styles), JWTs, and PEM private keys with [REDACTED-*] markers. Use whenever user-supplied or scraped text may carry credentials. Input: {text: string}. Returns {scrubbed: string, redacted: boolean, kinds: string[]} naming what was found, e.g. ['card','ssn']. Best-effort, not a guarantee. (1 MESH/call, a tool · safety)

text.description: REQUIRED — the text to scan; card numbers, SSNs, API keys/tokens, JWTs and PEM private keys are replaced with [REDACTED-*] markers
